ModMetaData.description:
Compatibility preview: adds Windows Steam 1.6.4871 rev590 and native Linux / Steam Deck 1.6.4871 rev600 support, including Linux texture processing and PNG caching alongside Loading Progress. No extra launch flag is required. PNG caching is opt-in and its first cache build can slow loading. Initial Steam Deck startup checks passed for five features; final Windows Steam and PNG cache live validation is pending. Settings changes require restart. Unsupported game/mod versions keep ordinary behavior. Do not enable alongside an older local copy of Wake-Up or the old validation package.
